params.state: Inbox state filter supported by notification capabilities.
params.cursor: Continuation returned by the previous page; send it unchanged with the same query.
params.limit: Page or window size within this operation’s published bounds.

operations.title: Read the unread notification count
operations.description: Returns the unread count for the selected audience. Refresh it after notification.changed rather than deriving it from event positions.

params.audience: Notification audience to read or act on, as allowed by the server.

operations.title: Change notification state
operations.description: Applies read or archive actions with an operation ID and expectedRevision. Use the inbox revision, which is independent of the event feed cursor.
notes: Send the current expectedRevision from this resource and reconcile conflicts before retrying.

operations.title: Query titles or provider IDs
operations.description: Lists one title kind in one library or finds a title by provider and providerId. Pages default to 50 and allow 1–100; cursors last 30 minutes and can finish a walk during a scan.

params.library: Library ID; required for a title list and optional for provider lookup.
params.kind: movie, show, season, episode, artist, album, song, book, author or collection.
params.order: Title-query direction: asc or desc; defaults to asc.
params.yearFrom: Earliest year, inclusive; use only with sort=year.
params.yearTo: Latest year, inclusive; use only with sort=year.
params.addedAfter: Include titles added after this RFC 3339 time; use only with sort=added.
params.addedBefore: Include titles added before this RFC 3339 time; use only with sort=added.
params.provider: Provider for an ID lookup: tmdb, tvdb, imdb or anilist.
params.providerId: Title ID at the named metadata provider; use with provider.
params.cursor: Continuation returned by the previous page; send it unchanged with the same query.
params.limit: Titles per page, 1–100; defaults to 50.

notes: Ranges are accepted only on the selected sort key. Reconcile an index by stable title ID when concurrent edits move sort keys.

operations.title: Report changed files or folders
operations.description: Accepts up to 200 absolute paths as the server sees them and queues scans of the affected folders. A 202 includes per-path status; outside_libraries means that path did not schedule work.
notes: Map paths to the server’s filesystem before sending them. Inspect each path’s status even when HTTP returns 202.
Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Start a library scan
operations.description: Queues an incremental, full or integrity scan for a library and returns 202. If a scan is already running, the server returns that scan; use changed paths when only particular folders changed.

params.mode: Scan mode: incremental, full or integrity.

notes: A 202 receipt or running job does not establish that the scan finished. Poll the job or check scan.finished webhooks.
Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Read library scan status
operations.description: Returns the library's current inventory and scan status, including progress and completed source scans. Players and tools can read it without owner-only job access.

operations.title: List scan jobs
operations.description: Returns scan job history for an owner integration. Use the returned items and continuation information to follow recent ingestion work.

params.libraryId: Library ID used to narrow scan jobs.
params.status: Scan job state, such as queued, running, complete or failed.
params.limit: Jobs per page, 1–40.
params.cursor: Continuation from the preceding scan-job page.

notes: The handler accepts libraryId, status, limit (1–40) and cursor even though this spec operation omits those query parameters.
Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Read a scan job
operations.description: Returns the current status, phase, processed counts and warnings for an ingestion job. A queued or running job is not proof that imported files are ready.
notes: A 202 receipt or running job does not establish that the scan finished. Poll the job or check scan.finished webhooks.
Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Cancel a scan job
operations.description: Requests cancellation of an ingestion job for the owner. Read the job again to reconcile its final outcome.
notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Read skipped scan entries
operations.description: Returns files and folders skipped by a scan, paged by sequence. Limit defaults to 64 and allows up to 128.

params.after: Sequence after which to read skipped entries.
params.limit: Entries per page, 1–128; defaults to 64.

notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Read source inventory changes
operations.description: Returns retained inventory changes for one library source after a sequence. Handle the returned cursor-expiry information by rebuilding the affected inventory.

params.after: Retained inventory sequence after which to read changes.

notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Read library inventory entries
operations.description: Returns paged inventory entries for an owner integration, with filters for source, asset or state. Use it to investigate unmatched or unavailable files without reading console panels.

params.sourceId: Source ID used to narrow or select this operation’s data.
params.assetId: Inventory asset ID used to narrow the results.
params.state: State filter supported by this resource.
params.cursor: Continuation returned by the previous page; send it unchanged with the same query.
params.limit: Page or window size within this operation’s published bounds.

notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Read a title's match and metadata
operations.description: Returns the repair state, current revision, match evidence and provider candidates for a supported entity kind. Read this before searching for or selecting a different match.

params.kind: Entity kind supported by metadata repair, such as item, show, season, album, artist or book.
params.id: Entity ID for the requested kind.

notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Change a title's match or metadata
operations.description: Applies a supported repair action such as searching, identifying a provider candidate or editing fields. Send the current expectedRevision and the action's required confirmation or operation ID; provider work can continue in the background.

params.kind: Entity kind supported by metadata repair, such as item, show, season, album, artist or book.
params.id: Entity ID for the requested kind.

notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.
Send the current expectedRevision from this resource and reconcile conflicts before retrying.

operations.title: List a library's uncertain matches
operations.description: Returns unmatched and uncertain titles with their best candidates for one library. Pages default to 25 and allow 1–50; includeInProgress controls whether work already running is listed.

params.cursor: Continuation returned by the previous page; send it unchanged with the same query.
params.limit: Titles per page, 1–50; defaults to 25.
params.includeInProgress: Whether to include titles whose metadata work is already running; defaults to true.

notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: List uncertain matches across libraries
operations.description: Returns a paged list of unmatched and uncertain titles across the server. Use it for a metadata integration's review queue.

params.cursor: Continuation returned by the previous page; send it unchanged with the same query.
params.limit: Titles per page, 1–50; defaults to 25.
params.includeInProgress: Whether to include titles whose metadata work is already running; defaults to true.

notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Count titles needing match review
operations.description: Returns counts for each library and the server total. Use it for an integration dashboard without fetching every uncertain title.
notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Resolve a title needing match review
operations.description: Accepts a candidate, searches, enters a provider ID or dismisses a title from the library's attention list. Send the command's current revision and inspect the accepted work after the 202 receipt.
notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.
Send the current expectedRevision from this resource and reconcile conflicts before retrying.

operations.title: Refresh an item's metadata
operations.description: Queues a fresh metadata fetch for the item and returns 202. Reread its details or match state after the background work finishes.
notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Refresh a show's metadata
operations.description: Queues a fresh metadata fetch for the show and returns 202. Existing metadata remains readable while the work runs.
notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Read editable item metadata
operations.description: Returns manually editable item metadata and its revision for the owner. Use this read before applying field changes.
notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.

operations.title: Edit item metadata
operations.description: Changes supported manual metadata fields under the owner's authority. Send the current revision and reconcile manual_metadata_conflict before retrying.
notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs library scope.
Send the current expectedRevision from this resource and reconcile conflicts before retrying.

operations.title: List active playback sessions
operations.description: Returns a paged list of active sessions with the viewer, title, device and delivery information. Refresh it after an admin.sessions event to keep a dashboard current.

params.limit: Page or window size within this operation’s published bounds.
params.cursor: Continuation returned by the previous page; send it unchanged with the same query.

notes: Requires administrator playback permission; an API key or personal token also needs admin scope.

operations.title: Read an active session's controls
operations.description: Returns the controls an administrator can use for a playback session and the current control revision. Read it before submitting an administrative control.
notes: Requires administrator playback permission; an API key or personal token also needs admin scope.

operations.title: Control an active session
operations.description: Applies an allowed playback action with expectedRevision and a position for seek where needed. Use the controls resource to check what the administrator may do.
notes: Requires administrator playback permission; an API key or personal token also needs admin scope.
Send the current expectedRevision from this resource and reconcile conflicts before retrying.

operations.title: End an active playback session
operations.description: Ends a viewer's playback and can show an optional message to them. The operation is idempotent.
notes: Requires administrator playback permission; an API key or personal token also needs admin scope.

operations.title: List webhooks and event types
operations.description: Returns configured webhooks and the event types available for subscriptions. Secrets are represented by hints.
notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs admin scope.

operations.title: Create a webhook
operations.description: Adds a destination and event subscription and returns its signing secret once. URLs may use HTTP or HTTPS, including a private network address, but cannot contain a username or password.
notes: Keep the signing secret privately; it is shown only when issued or replaced.
Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs admin scope.

operations.title: Read a webhook
operations.description: Returns one webhook's configuration, revision and delivery state. Read it before changing a subscription.
notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs admin scope.

operations.title: Change a webhook
operations.description: Changes the destination, events or enabled state using expectedRevision. Setting rotateSecret returns the replacement signing secret once; disabling a webhook abandons queued deliveries.
notes: Keep the signing secret privately; it is shown only when issued or replaced.
Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs admin scope.
Send the current expectedRevision from this resource and reconcile conflicts before retrying.

operations.title: Delete a webhook
operations.description: Removes the webhook together with its waiting deliveries and delivery log. Use this when an integration is disconnected.
notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs admin scope.

operations.title: Send a webhook test
operations.description: Queues a webhook.test event even if the webhook is disabled and returns 202. Check the delivery log to confirm that the receiver accepted it.
notes: Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs admin scope.

operations.title: Read webhook delivery results
operations.description: Returns a paged delivery log, newest first, with attempt counts and HTTP results. Event IDs stay the same across retries so receivers can ignore duplicate deliveries.

params.cursor: Continuation returned by the previous page; send it unchanged with the same query.
params.limit: Page or window size within this operation’s published bounds.

notes: Verify signatures against the raw request body, reject stale timestamps and deduplicate Portico-Event-Id values at the receiver.
Requires the owner; an API key or personal token also needs admin scope.

operations.title: Call the MCP server
operations.description: Accepts MCP JSON-RPC over stateless Streamable HTTP, with JSON responses and no session ID to retain. Use initialize, tools/list and tools/call with an API key or personal token; signed-in app sessions are refused.
notes: Use an API key or personal access token; the route’s open scope label does not mean unauthenticated MCP access.
POST supports initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call and notifications. GET returns 405; there is no server event stream.
Supported protocol versions: 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26 and 2024-11-05. Tools are filtered by scope, role and configured features.
